evidence.notes: Database.insert accepts a List<Object> containing SObject values with AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE and returns ordered SaveResult rows.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeDatabaseInsertListAccessLevelEvidenceTest { @isTest static void insertsObjectListWithAccessLevel() { List<Object> records = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'Access List One'), new Account(Name = 'Access List Two')}; List<Database.SaveResult> results = Database.insert(records, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, results.size()); System.assert(results[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(results[1].isSuccess()); System.assertNotEquals(null, results[0].getId()); System.assertNotEquals(null, results[1].getId()); System.assertEquals(2, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name IN ('Access List One', 'Access List Two')]); } }
